heavyPrompts.prompt: A real, candid DSLR photograph (not a 3D render, not CGI), shot on a 50mm lens from about 2.5 meters away, camera exactly level and square to the front of the object. ONE long continuous vertical barrel hinge running nearly the full height of the door's right edge, exactly like the reference. On the door, upper-middle slightly right of center: one round combination dial with a white/brushed-silver engraved ring with fine black tick marks (no readable numerals), a black knurled center knob, set into a black oval escutcheon; a small fixed triangular index mark at 12 o'clock above the ring; a black horizontal lever handle extending left from the escutcheon; a small key lock just below the dial. No logo, no brand name, no text, no stickers. Small dark rubber feet under the base. Realistic minor wear: faint scuffs, a few fine scratches, slight dust. The safe sits centered on a faded, worn red-and-beige Persian rug laid on worn, scratched oak floorboards, against a warm gray, slightly uneven old lime-plaster wall with a low wooden skirting board. Soft diffuse window light from the upper left, natural falloff, soft contact shadow on the rug and a soft shadow to the right on the wall. Framing: the safe occupies only about half of the image height, centered, with clear wall visible above it and clear rug visible below it and on both sides. Natural, slightly muted color, fine film grain, realistic photographic depth.
